_about: Roadmap progress. Each phase is a weighted list of items; weight is the item's share of that phase's effort, done its completion from 0 to 1. kind 'measured' means tools/progress.py computes done from the repository (or a census figure it records here); 'estimate' means a judgement, with its evidence. See docs/progress.md.

P1.item: Translation, lockstep, routes and the emulated PC (roadmap Phase 1 'Done')
P1.evidence: All 17 code files translated (89,276 instructions); instruction lockstep 0 mismatches over 5.7M states; 27 routes identical across engines; fidelity.py 1,210/1,210; housekeeping done.

P1.item: The picture against DOSBox, frame by frame
P1.evidence: The SVGA_S3 screen-off fix removes five false black local pictures. DOSBox 0.74 source confirms fractional PIC scheduling from pixel clock/CRTC totals; local frame, line-part, retrace, status and I/O slice deadlines now use rational event times with whole-instruction ceiling boundaries. After the pc_slice_left refinement, saved independent capture intro-qlh_wi26 matches 1,329/1,332 exact pictures, with three one-sample logo images unmatched on each side and -0.000034 ms end drift. Fresh capture intro-cfku0zec matches 1,321/1,332, with 11 one-sample images unmatched on each side and +14.268 ms drift. The local 1,332-picture sequences are identical; remaining transition differences depend on reference capture phase. No multi-sample mismatch remains; exact frame parity is open.
Integration, MIDI parity and offline rendering done; independent reference PCM and a listening check open.

Recon primary and return inputs have been refreshed after rational VGA slice-boundary timing; both pass paired strong observers, and the return route also passes the official world, VGAME-exit and END-debrief gates. Strike and strike-return proofs still need refresh. Independent GOG DOSBox cargo reproduction and wider generated-assignment coverage remain open.
Promotion, medals, tour ribbon and rank-3 retirement earned and paired; rank-6 'General, At Last!' branch open.
Keyboard/mouse/joystick paths exist and record sessions; no structured playtest of controls, saves and feel yet.
PIT control-word IRQ found and fixed; I/O slice suppression matched; exact retrace phase (the one-frame channel-3 note) and PLAYER's few-byte DAC gap open.

DBOPL default, mixer rounding fixed; intro waveform within about 0.5% RMS but not exact. A seeded type-8 flight now has a 62.3-second independent GOG DOSBox WAV; approximate host alignment reaches 58.15 seconds (envelope correlation 0.598, waveform 0.361, median spectral cosine 0.972, RMS 0.1011 vs 0.0920), not exact parity. The route's PC-speaker gate is clear; speech, audible speaker output and listening remain open.

P3.item: Stage 0: measure what draws, and an observer that logs the drawing primitives per frame
P3.evidence: Measured and written up (docs/presentation.md) and the observer is built: hooks on game_draw, the matched projection, VGAME's fill and outline paths and every graphics library entry (lines, span fills, blits decoded; the rest logged with their page changes), f117run --observe, hashes unchanged with it on, ROM-free unit test. Not yet: a vertex observer on the original's own (non-matched) projection path.

P3.item: Stage 1: draw lists replayed bit-exact at 320x200
P3.evidence: Whole phases rebuilt byte for byte over the 64 KB work page and the A000 display page (tools/drawlist_frame.py): 73 of 73 phases on 30M instructions of the strike flight, and every phase of 30M-instruction windows of four more routes (recon 34, Central Europe air-to-air 29, landing 38, cargo 38), with no byte copied from the original on any of them. Work-page changes replay by rule; direct display writes from uncoded graphics entries are replayed from captured byte deltas. The remaining work is coverage of the other routes and unexercised branches (dithered fills, the sprite clip edge cases).
